name: services/terms/search
description:
Search for terms matching the given query and/or filters.

By default, this method will search among all terms. If you'd like to search only in a limited subset of them, then try using some of the optional parameters.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description:
The search query. Query is not tokenized and (as a whole) is matched against any part of term name or id. Proper tokenization will likely be added in the future.

Returns all terms that satisfy other criteria if omitted.

arguments.name: min_finish_date
arguments.description: Date string (YYYY-MM-DD). If given, then only those terms which are finished on this day (inclusive), or later, will be returned.

arguments.name: max_start_date
arguments.description: Date string (YYYY-MM-DD). If given, then only those terms which start on this day (inclusive), or earlier, will be returned.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: List of terms objects as defined in the term method.
